stem: A survey gives a 95% confidence interval of 18.2% to 21.8% for the share of customers who prefer a new price plan. Which statement about the 95% is right?

options.text: 95% of the customers gave answers between 18.2% and 21.8%
Repeated many times, about 95% of such intervals contain the true share
The true share is exactly 20.0%, and the interval only shows the rounding
95% of future surveys will find a share between 18.2% and 21.8%
